description: This file contains the serialization, surrogate conversion, and deep copying logic for the NameValueCollection class within the Orleans framework. It defines a serializer, surrogate type, and copier specifically for NameValueCollection, enabling efficient serialization and cloning of such objects in distributed environments.

classes.name: NameValueCollectionCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for NameValueCollection, converting it to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: NameValueCollectionSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate data structure representing NameValueCollection, used during serialization.

classes.name: NameValueCollectionCopier
classes.description: Deep copy implementation for NameValueCollection instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a NameValueCollection.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a NameValueCollection into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a NameValueCollection.
